instruction: Orient a cylinder along a 3D vector (bonds, struts)
input: Three.js r128. For a bond/strut between two points: compute midpoint, length, and direction, then scale.y = length and quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0), dir). Works for molecule bonds, antennae, cables, spider legs.

instruction: QA rule: a GUI app must have working JavaScript — not just styled HTML
input: An app for a weather dashboard passed visual inspection but had zero <script> tags: no search, no unit toggle, no data updates. Why is that a failure, and what must a GUI app contain?
output: A GUI app's job is INTERACTION. HTML+CSS alone is a static mockup. A complete app needs: (1) a <script> block with the state and logic, (2) event wiring — button.onclick / addEventListener for every control, (3) a render path that updates the DOM from state (render() called on input). Structure: elements in HTML, logic in JS, state changes re-render the UI. A page with no scripts cannot do any of this.

instruction: Dispose + rebuild pattern for dynamic scenes
input: Three.js r128. Any 'regenerate' button must dispose the old objects or the scene leaks GPU memory: scene.remove(group), traverse children calling geometry.dispose() (+ material.dispose() for unique mats), then rebuild. Grouped per-material InstancedMesh keeps this cheap.

instruction: Procedural terrain from fractal value noise
input: Three.js r128. Seeded LCG value noise with smoothstep interpolation; fbm = 6 octaves, amplitude halving and frequency doubling, normalized. Displace a PlaneGeometry's vertices, recompute normals, then color bands by height (water/sand/grass/rock/snow). Rebuild on a roughness slider.

instruction: Comet trails with a Points ribbon
input: Three.js r128. A trail = a Points buffer you shift every frame: copy each point to the next slot, slot 0 = the head position. AdditiveBlending makes overlapping points glow. Keep a fixed TRAIL count (e.g. 24).

instruction: Fix the 3D chess app (broken texture URLs)
input: The app 404'd on threejs.org/examples/textures/chess1.png, chess2.png, wood.jpg. Never depend on external image assets. Fix it: generate the checkerboard with a canvas + CanvasTexture (fill 8x8 alternating squares), and give pieces solid MeshStandardMaterial colors instead of image textures.
output:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
	<meta charset="UTF-8">
	<title>3D Chess Game</title>
	<style>
		body { margin: 0; }
		canvas { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
	</style>
</head>
<body>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.128.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>

<script>
	
	var scene = new THREE.Scene();
	scene.background = new THREE.Color('grey');
	
	var camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
	camera.position.set(0, 0, 10);
	
	var renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
	renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
	document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
	
	var controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
	controls.enableDamping = true;
	controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;
	
	var light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
	light.position.set(1, 1, 1).normalize();
	scene.add(light);
	
	function makeCheckerTexture() {
		var c = document.createElement('canvas');
		c.width = c.height = 256;
		var ctx = c.getContext('2d');
		var s = 32;
		for (var x = 0; x < 8; x++) {
			for (var y = 0; y < 8; y++) {
				ctx.fillStyle = (x + y) % 2 ? '#3a2414' : '#e8d3a3';
				ctx.fillRect(x * s, y * s, s, s);
			}
		}
		return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
	}
	var boardTexture = makeCheckerTexture();
	var boardGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(8, 8, 0.1);
	var boardMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: boardTexture, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
	var board = new THREE.Mesh(boardGeometry, boardMaterial);
	scene.add(board);
	
	var pieceGeometries = [];
	var pieceMaterials = [];
	for (var i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
		var geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 0.1);
		var material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: i % 2 ? 0xdddddd : 0x333333, roughness: 0.5 });
		pieceGeometries.push(geometry);
		pieceMaterials.push(material);
	}
	var pieces = [];
	for (var i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
		var mesh = new THREE.Mesh(pieceGeometries[i], pieceMaterials[i]);
		pieces.push(mesh);
		scene.add(mesh);
	}
	
	var selectedPiece = null;
	var selectedSquare = null;
	var movePiece = function(mesh, square) {
		
		mesh.position.set(square.x * 1.5, square.y * 1.5, -0.5);
		
		selectedPiece = null;
		selectedSquare = null;
	};
	var highlightSquare = function(square) {
		
		var highlightGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.5, 1.5, 0.1);
		var highlightMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff0000, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
		var highlightMesh = new THREE.Mesh(highlightGeometry, highlightMaterial);
		highlightMesh.position.set(square.x * 1.5, square.y * 1.5, -0.5);
		scene.add(highlightMesh);
		
		var children = scene.children.filter(function(child) { return child.name === 'highlight'; });
		for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
			scene.remove(children[i]);
		}
	};
	
	var turn = 0;
	var turnIndicator = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, side: THREE.DoubleSide }));
	turnIndicator.position.set(9 * 1.5, 0, -0.5);
	turnIndicator.name = 'turnIndicator';
	scene.add(turnIndicator);
	
	var render = function() {
		requestAnimationFrame(render);
		
		if (selectedPiece) {
			var square = selectedSquare;
			var piece = selectedPiece;
			
			if (turn % 2 === 0) {
				
				
			} else {
				
				
			}
			
			movePiece(piece, square);
			
			highlightSquare(square);
		}
		
		controls.update();
		
		renderer.render(scene, camera);
	};
	
	render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
